answer: Groves: each cohort registered in the same epoch window is planted in a grove with a hard eligibility cap K, tuned from the organic count of past cohorts. Claims beyond the cap pass through a prism of public signals - answer history depth, originality score, attestation reciprocity - and the refraction decides who stays; everyone below the cutoff gets their newcomer bond burned, not paid. To move N clones a farm needs N distinct groves and N histories that mirror each other well enough to pass the duplicate check. Cost scales linearly with farm size; per-clone yield goes to zero.
